March 17, 2018 - By Nellie Frank 
Stillwater Capital Advisors Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 2.22% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Stillwater Capital Advisors Llc bought 2,326 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 107,309 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $16.54 million, up from 104,983 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Stillwater Capital Advisors Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $903.28 billion market cap company.
